digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center transport adapter and TicketTransport protocol
propositions: DC transport lacks 12 methods called by the core reconciler; implementing only set_entity_property moves the crash deeper without completing the capability
Seven of the twelve absent methods have call sites that swallow all exceptions, causing silent degradation (no comments, links, properties synced) rather than crashes
Reporter sync churns on every pass because _identity_of reads only accountId (null on DC) instead of name; implementing set_reporter without fixing _identity_of produces infinite re-emission
TicketTransport protocol is not @runtime_checkable, so isinstance conformance checks raise TypeError; absence of members is not detectable at construction time
Cloud's get_parent_map uses /rest/api/3/search/jql with cursor pagination (rejects startAt with HTTP 400); DC v2 requires offset pagination on /rest/api/2/search
